supersession_scope: pre-run tightening of verdict/validity logic plus persistence only; no held-out trajectory had run
angle_structural_rule: Delta_G > 0.009 at both N=128 and N=160
angle_gain_only_rule: Delta_gain > 0.015 at both resolutions and Delta_G <= 0.009 at both resolutions

verdict_logic.invalid: any mandatory validity gate fails -> INCONCLUSIVE
verdict_logic.structural_pass: at least 3 of 4 structural angles -> HISTORY_RESPONSE_GEOMETRY_PASS
verdict_logic.gain_only: otherwise at least 3 of 4 gain-only angles -> HISTORY_GAIN_ONLY
